issues.description: validate_conda uses substring matching on --version output, accepting impostors.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag that `any(tool in out.decode().lower() ...)` admits false positives: any binary whose output contains 'conda' or 'mamba' (e.g. 'anaconda-build', paths like /opt/anaconda/...) passes. Tighten the postcondition by checking the basename or parsing the first token of stdout against an exact tool name.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the file browser hides valid conda executables on Linux and macOS.
issues.detail: The browse dialog filter is unconditionally '*.exe', a Windows-only assumption. On Linux/macOS, `conda`, `mamba`, and `micromamba` have no extension and become invisible in the picker. Make the filter platform-conditional or use 'All files'.

issues.description: kernelspec argv() uses the custom conda path without re-validating it at use time.
issues.detail: When `custom_conda` is True and auto-detect fails, the configured path is consumed without re-checking that it still exists, is executable, and is conda-family. The 'valid conda executable' invariant does not survive across the config boundary; stale or broken paths reach the kernel launch path. Re-validate on use and surface a precise error.

issues.description: validate_conda returns True for empty string, conflating 'unset' with 'verified executable'.
issues.detail: The function returns True for '' so the preferences page does not flag an empty field, but the advertised postcondition ('points to a working conda-like executable') is violated by construction. Split the contract (is_empty vs is_valid) or treat empty as a precondition violation handled at the call site.

issues.description: run_program(...).communicate() has no timeout and can hang the preferences UI.
issues.detail: A misidentified or hung binary at the user-supplied path will block until communicate() returns, with no timeout, kill, or context manager. Add a timeout and ensure the process is terminated on failure so the validator has a well-founded bound.

issues.description: Empty-string sentinel plus custom_conda boolean encodes the same state twice.
issues.detail: `conda_path: ''` combined with a `custom_conda` flag double-encodes 'no custom path', forcing validate_conda to special-case ''. A single Optional[str] (None means unset) would make the data flow self-evident and eliminate drift between the two fields.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is small and reasonably structured but the validator's contract is loose: substring matching on --version admits impostors, and empty input incorrectly returns True. A Windows-only '*.exe' filter silently breaks the file picker on Linux and macOS. The kernelspec consumer trusts the persisted custom path without re-validating it at use time, so the 'valid conda executable' invariant does not survive across the config boundary. Secondary concerns: no timeout on the validation subprocess and a redundant boolean+path data shape. Tighten the postcondition, make the filter platform-aware, and re-validate at use.
